grain: one row per oven per day; the row is the 09:00 prediction opportunity for that oven

columns.name: day
columns.description: Day index 1 to 120; the time-based split is on this column.

columns.name: date
columns.description: Calendar date of the row (ISO 8601); day 1 is 2026-03-02.

columns.name: oven_age_years
columns.description: Age of the oven in years, constant per oven.

columns.name: days_since_service
columns.description: Days since the last service or repair, known from the maintenance log at 09:00.

columns.name: temp_mean_c
columns.description: Mean chamber temperature over the previous 24 hours, degrees C.

columns.name: temp_max_c
columns.description: Maximum chamber temperature over the previous 24 hours, degrees C.

columns.name: door_cycles
columns.description: Door open/close cycles in the previous 24 hours.

columns.name: fault_next_24h
columns.description: 1 when the oven had a fault stop in the 24 hours after 09:00, else 0. The target, never a feature.

columns.name: repair_minutes
columns.description: Minutes the technician spent on the repair; 0 when there was no fault. Written after the event this row predicts, so it leaks the label.

columns.name: fault_code
columns.description: Technician's fault code (F-HEAT, F-DOOR, F-CTRL), empty when there was no fault. Also written after the event.
